guideImpact.reason: The reviewed Call workflow adds a call summary and annotated timeline to the shared point-detail dialog, with sortable samples and navigation from a sample to its related Service details. The current guide covers Automobile Service results, so users need an additional section explaining how to inspect Call results.

guideUpdate.title: Map and inspect Automobile Call results
steps: In GIS, open the Automobile layer configuration and select Call under Test type.
Add the Call layer, then select a map point to open its Call details.
Read the available call duration, result, connection time, start and end times, handset, and disconnection cause in the summary.
Inspect the timeline for call-state annotations, signal strength, and Service, which represents service technology.
Select a sample-table heading to sort the returned Call samples.
Read the Site and Cell columns for serving-cell information; when it is unavailable, read the sample CGI.
Select a Call sample to open the related Service details for that point in time.
Select a Call point with no measurable duration to view its No data available state.
screenshotCaptions: A completed Automobile Call detail shows the available summary fields.
The Call timeline shows call-state annotations and signal strength, with Service listed as the service technology.
Returned Call samples appear in the detail table.
The sample table shows Site and Cell columns and CGI fallback data.
The selected Call sample opens Service details for the matching time and cell.
A zero-duration Call shows No data available with its summary and no sample table.
guideUpdate.reason: Adds instructions for mapping Automobile Call results, reading their summary, timeline and samples, and opening related Service details.
